facts.fact: The news agency ANP reports that President Issoufou on 10 July 2017 instructed an update of the sector policy dating from 2012 (politique sectorielle datant de 2012), which implies a sector policy in place since 2012; the report gives no more on its adoption.
ANP reports that on 10 July 2017 President Issoufou instructed that the sector policy dating from 2012 be updated; no draft is mentioned.
